techniques.evidence: src/app/api/error-memory/route.ts:44 The only recall door has no caller: grep finds no client of 'get-relevant-errors', and PromptBuilder's errorMemory option (prompt-builder.ts:70) is never supplied, so formatErrorMemory in prompt-context.ts never fires.

src/lib/error-memory-db.ts:21 The store is keyed by module, not by owning project, in the single shared ~/.pof DB. The tree admits it: build-error-recurrence.ts:14 says error_memory 'has no project column'.

src/app/api/error-memory/route.ts:55 The only lifecycle operation is a resolved flag, which the upsert resets on recurrence (error-memory-db.ts:115). There is no cap, no retirement and no delete, so the store only grows.
src/app/api/error-memory/route.ts:31 Each capture is folded into a counter row with no build or run id, so no bounded episode record survives for provenance to cite.

src/lib/error-memory-db.ts:193 An undesigned cut: rows are pre-truncated by occurrences before keyword relevance is scored, so a keyword-matching error ranked 31st can never be recalled, and nothing reports the cut.
